system.name: OISA (Online Iterative Self-Alignment)
system.one_liner: A radiology report generation model generates, scores and aligns on its own multi-objective preference data, round after round.

content.variant_note: two titled dashed modules (data construction, alignment) read as one clockwise loop closed by a red return arrow; the alignment module also shows the objective wiring
content.argues: The RRG model can improve itself by generating, scoring and aligning on its own multi-objective preference data, round after round.
content.subject: Chest X-ray prompts turned into grouped reports, then preference data, then an updated model that loops back to generation.

lessons.suits: Iterative self-improvement or alignment pipelines with a data-construction module and a training module, possibly with several objectives.

evidence: The pipeline involves four steps: self-generation to obtain diverse data, self-evaluation to obtain a multi-objective preference dataset
Figure 1 illustrates the proposed OISA framework, comprising two modules and iterating through four steps

summary: OISA improves a radiology report generation model by letting it generate, score and align on its own data, iteratively. Figure 1 draws this as a clockwise loop over two dashed modules. In Preference Datasets Construction the reference RRG model, given chest X-rays and a one-hot weight vector, writes reports that are deduplicated and grouped (Step 1); a boxed pseudocode then ranks them by a metric to build chosen and rejected preference data D1 to DN (Step 2). In Multi-Objective Alignment, frozen reward models and the datasets feed the model through weights, margins and BCE-with-margin lines in blue and orange (Step 3), and a red arrow returns the updated model to Step 1 (Step 4). Tinted regions, small icons and serif text.
summary_zh: OISA 让放射学报告生成模型自己生成、评分并对齐数据。图画成两个虚线模块组成的顺时针闭环：先由胸片和独热权重生成并分组报告，再用伪代码框构造多目标偏好数据，随后结合奖励模型边际更新模型，红箭头把新模型送回第一步。
